# Support
Heres how You can support me and the project. (WIP)

Thank you for using our project! We want to make sure you have the best possible experience. Please review the resources below to find the help you need or learn how to support our work.

## Need Help?
If you have questions about using this project, run into issues, or need to clarify a concept, please start by doing the following:
1. **Check the Documentation:** Review the `README.md` and our [Documentation](insert-docs-link-here) to see if your question is already answered.
2. **Search Existing Issues:** Check the [GitHub Issues](insert-repo-issues-url-here) page to see if someone else has already asked or solved your problem.
3. **Talk to a Duck:** Try to define exactly what you are trying to do, what problem you are encountering, and what steps you've taken so far. 

## Reporting Bugs
If you have found a bug in the project, please help us fix it quickly by [opening a Bug Report](insert-new-issue-url-here). 
* Please provide sample code, screenshots, or error logs if possible.
* Clearly outline the steps required to reproduce the issue.

## Suggesting Enhancements
We are always looking to improve! If you have an idea or feature request, please [submit a Feature Request](insert-new-issue-url-here) and tell us how this enhancement would benefit the project.

## How You Can Support the Project
Love using this project? There are several easy, non-code ways you can show your support and help the community grow:
* **Star the Repository:** Click the ⭐ "Star" button at the top of the repository page.
* **Share the Project:** Mention the project at local meetups, on social media, or tell your colleagues about it!
* **Add a Backlink:** If you are using this in your own project, link back to this repository in your `README.md`. 
* **Become a Sponsor:** If you would like to financially support the maintenance and development of this project, consider [sponsoring us here](insert-sponsorship-link-here). 

Thank you for your support!
